sloka: प्रहस्तस्तु समाश्वस्तो दृष्ट्वा बद्धं दशाननम् ।सह तै राक्षसैः क्रुद्धश्चाभिदुद्राव पार्थिवम् ।। ७.३२.६७ ॥
transliteration: prahastastu samāśvasto dṛṣṭvā baddhaṁ daśānanam ।saha tai rākṣasaiḥ kruddhaścābhidudrāva pārthivam ।। 7.32.67 ॥

translations.english: But Prahasta, having recovered from his shock upon seeing Daśānana bound, became enraged and, along with those Rākṣasas, rushed towards the king.
